name: write-natural-text
description: One skill, $write-natural-text, that writes, rewrites, or checks English text so it reads like a real person wrote it: plain B1-level words, a personal view, uneven structure, no AI writing tells, ASCII punctuation only. Ships the voice guide and a research-backed catalog of AI writing signals with the fix for each.

interface.shortDescription: Plain, human-sounding English at B1 level with no AI writing tells.
interface.longDescription: Writes, rewrites, or checks English text so it reads like a real person wrote it. Default voice: a fourth-year student who knows the subject and explains it in ordinary words. Covers course answers, social posts, one-line additions, and longer articles. Bundles a voice guide and a catalog of measured AI writing signals (participial clauses, nominalizations, rule of three, symmetric arguments, generic vocabulary, formatting habits) with the fix for each, plus a final checklist.
defaultPrompt: Write a course answer that reads like my own writing.
Rewrite this draft so it does not look machine-written.
Check this text for AI writing tells.
Add one line to this post in the same voice.
